summary: Domark and Time Warner Interactive's Kawasaki-licensed motorcycle racer using the engine lineage of Lankhor's F1, released for 16-bit consoles and Game Gear.

entries.title: Kawasaki Superbike Challenge
entries.definitive_edition: Genesis / Mega Drive primary; Game Gear for two-player mode

emulation.emulator: Genesis Plus GX / BlastEm / SameBoy or Gearsystem for Game Gear
emulation.notes: Use Genesis/Mega Drive emulation for the main route and Game Gear hardware/emulation only for the multiplayer secondary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: 16-bit Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with modern scaling

primary.why: Kawasaki Superbike Challenge released on Genesis/Mega Drive, Super NES, and Game Gear. The Genesis/Mega Drive version is the selected main route among the 16-bit releases, while the Game Gear version is worth preserving only for its sourced two-player handheld mode.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Genesis/Mega Drive version in Genesis Plus GX, BlastEm, MiSTer, or original hardware; use Game Gear only if you want to sample its two-player mode.

secondary.exclusive_content: Two-player handheld mode praised in contemporary coverage.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Game Gear version's two-player mode if preserving platform-specific play.
secondary.why: Genesis/Mega Drive is the main fidelity route; Game Gear has a sourced handheld multiplayer feature.

entries.remaster_caveats: Known in Europe as Kawasaki Superbikes; no sourced remaster.
